create_FlowMatchLCMScheduler: create a FlowMatchLCMScheduler instance with custom num_train_timesteps and shift parameters for flow matching
set_timesteps_FlowMatchLCMScheduler: set the discrete timesteps for the FlowMatchLCMScheduler before running inference with a given number of steps
step_FlowMatchLCMScheduler: run one denoising step with the FlowMatchLCMScheduler using model output and current timestep to get the previous sample
scale_noise_FlowMatchLCMScheduler: apply the forward flow-matching process to add scaled noise to a sample at a given timestep
convert_to_karras_sigmas_FlowMatchLCMSch: convert the sigma schedule to Karras sigmas for improved noise scheduling during sampling
